notes.title: Instant Dungeon! v1.74 Released
notes.content:
This is a maintenance release that includes the following fixes:

	Added small window with a progress bar during game's initial setup phase.
	Names longer than 22 characters abbreviated with '...' when viewing Steam Leaderboards in game.
	Proper Steam names requested for Steam leaderboard entries appearing as '[unknown]'. 
	Fixed errant black pixels appearing at bottom of Steam Leaderboard viewer scroll box.

notes.title: Instant Dungeon! v1.72 Released
notes.content:
This release is a hot fix which addresses the following issues:
	Fixed a bug that prevented the game from starting after downloading Steam leaderboards.
	Fixed a bug that caused stale Steam leaderboard to be displayed at the end of a game.
	Fixed a bug that prevented manually refreshing Steam leaderboards when viewed at the end of a game (after local high score name entry).

notes.title: Instant Dungeon! v1.70 Released
notes.content:
Steam online leaderboards added!

Some notes about the Steam leaderboards feature:
There is a Steam leaderboard for each game flavor (except 'Practice Formula').
Only one score (the highest) per SteamID per leaderboard.
Your best score for each game flavor will automatically be submitted when the game starts up. (This means your existing high scores should be submitted as soon as you start the game with version 1.70 or newer).
New scores are automatically submitted at the end of each game.
Steam leaderboards can viewed by selecting 'High Scores' from the Options menu then selecting 'Next' on the local leaderboard viewer.
Only the top 100 leaderboard entries are displayed.
Steam names with non-Latin characters in them may not display correctly on leaderboards.
Steam leaderboards are auto-refreshed every 5 minutes when viewing them.
Steam leaderboards can be manually refreshed by pressing F7 while viewing them.

Additional changes:
Added an announcement (text and audio queue) when a new game flavor is unlocked.
Joystick deadzone option added to the 'Controls' menu.
Default joysick deadzone slightly increased.
'j' key also mapped to 'Action' button.
'Start' button on X360 pad also mapped to 'Pause'.
Fixed bug with friend placement in 'Rescue Relish' flavor.


Thanks to Ahoron for reporting the rescue friend placement bug and for the prompting to add flavor unlock notifications!
Thanks to PrettzL for suggesting the Joystick deadzone changes!
Thanks to ProPooperator for suggesting adding the 'j' key as an option for 'Action'!

notes.title: Instant Dungeon! v1.68 Released
notes.content:
Changes:
	Fixed bug when creating save folder for high scores.
	Fixed crash bug when reading/logging name of game controller.
	Additional logging during OpenGL initialization.
	Additional logging during asset bank loading.
	Additional logging during Joystick initialization.
	'x' and 'c' keys also mapped to the 'Action' button.


Special thanks to Dan for reporting the high scores issue and to PrettzL for all his helping finding and fixing the controller crash bug!
Also thanks to Zincoshine for the suggestion to add 'x' and 'c' as 'Action' buttons!

notes.title: Instant Dungeon! now with Steam Trading Cards and Achievements
notes.content:
[h1]Instant Dungeon! is [b]15% off from May 11 - 14[/b] to celebrate its newly added features; [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] and [b]Steam Achievements[/b].[/h1]

[h1]Steam Achievements:[/h1]

There are [b]51 achievements[/b], you can view them from the Steam client or by selecting "Achievements" from the options or pause menu in-game.

You can see the achievements here:
http://steamcommunity.com/stats/326720/achievements

[h1]Steam Trading Cards:[/h1]

You can now grab [b]5 trading cards[/b] each is an original composition by the artist Lukasz Jastrzebski. There are also [b]5 profile backgrounds[/b] and [b]5 emoticons[/b] which you will be able to collect randomly by crafting badges.
